parameters.context: LB, 37 C, ciprofloxacin; Regoes et al. 2004
parameters.notes: Reference PD dataset; rate convention must be converted consistently before combining with local biomass model.
Aggregate selected phenotype rate, not automatically a single genotype-edge probability.

transfer_assumptions: The reference pharmacodynamic curve and the MG1655 genotype table come from different experimental systems.
Before calling the combined scenario quantitatively calibrated, normalize/fit the PD response to the selected genotype MICs and verify rate conventions.
Spatial diffusion and colony-dispersal coefficients remain scenario-calibration parameters until source-matched values are chosen.
The resource-by-drug policy maps the transferred PD decrement to a first-order loss channel; it is not source-matched stationary-phase calibration.

unbound_requirements.notes: Do not substitute the Regoes CAB1 drug-free log10 density slope without an explicit, unit-consistent composition decision.
Must match the chosen limiting-resource definition and concentration units.
Required to connect resource consumption to biomass production.
Coarse spatial approximation; must remain visibly distinct from physical single-cell measurements.
For the ciprofloxacin flagship, the hazard is derived from reference_pd_decrement_as_first_order_loss_v1 rather than set as a free scalar. Other mechanisms require their own provenance.

resource_drug.notes: The loss channel is the decrement relative to the Regoes drug-free reference. Petra's Monod growth baseline remains independently provenance-owned; starvation interaction is not source-matched calibration.
